VQA-03.prompt_excerpt: Suppose visual QA found that the BookCard component has a border using a hardcoded color instead of a design token. Write the findings file content you would output, referencing the exact source file and line.
VQA-03.output:
```
FAIL
Gate: 1 failure

Fix now:
- src/components/BookCard/BookCard.css:14 `.book-card`
  Test: "BookCard renders with correct border @visual" (tests/acceptance/BookCard.spec.ts:42)
  Assertion: `expect(borderColor).toBe('var(--color-border-default)')`
  Expected: var(--color-border-default)
  Received: #cccccc
  Cause: [Tokens > borders > no-hardcoded-colors] Border color uses a hardcoded hex value instead of the required design token, causing it to ignore theme overrides and fail dark-mode contrast checks.
  Fix: Replace `border: 1px solid #cccccc;` with `border: 1px solid var(--color-border-default);`

Flaky: 0
Contract gaps: 0
Review findings: None
```

Key things to note about this format per the instructions:

- `FAIL` because there is at least one `Fix now` item
- The cause begins with a bracketed rule reference `[Tokens > borders > no-hardcoded-colors]`
- Expected/Received are literal values, not descriptions
- The Fix is exact — what to remove and what to replace it with
- File, line, and selector are pinpointed so the fixer needs zero exploration
